name: cyclotron
description: Closed form: t = (7/6) pi m / (|q| B). An m/z 100 cation accelerated through 1 kV and launched along +x into a uniform 0.5 T field along +z goes round a circle of radius r = m v / (|q| B) = 91.057 mm, clockwise seen from +z (F = q v x B points to -y). The detector is the plane x = -r/2, which the ion first crosses seven twelfths of the way round, so the flight time is 7/12 of the cyclotron period 2 pi m / (|q| B) = 13.024 us - a period with no energy in it at all. With B ignored, or with the field-free drift shortcut taken inside the magnet, the ion flies straight away from the detector and never arrives. The sense of rotation is not checked here (a mirror-image orbit crosses the same plane at the same instant); the unit tests check it. The expectation is arithmetic this engine had no part in.
